newsitem.title: USA: Conn. unemployment rate steadies at 4.7 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Conn. unemployment rate steadies at 4.7 pct in Aug.

text.p: Connecticut's nonfarm employment steadied at 4.7 percent in August, though nonfarm unemployment gained 4,000 jobs, the state Department of Labor said on Tuesday.
"Job gains in recent months and other positive economic indicators reinforce optimism for a continued recovery," said Salvatore DiPilo, labor statistics supervisor, in prepared remarks.
The trade sector was the leader, adding 1,700 jobs, followed by servies, which gained 1,400, and manufacturing, which climbed 1,000.
However, the finance, insurance and real estate sector shed 400 jobs, while construction and mining lost 300 jobs.
